items.body: A group-membership request may be fulfilled only when approved by the requested-for person's line manager (per the HR system). If the manager is on leave, their delegate recorded in the service desk may approve; record the delegate as the approver. Nobody may approve their own request - treat a self-approval as no approval: set approval back to pending and put the request on hold. Privileged groups additionally require approval from the Security group; until then put the request on hold. Reject  ... (trimmed)
